OUR SERVICES

What We Do

Complete electrical and technical solutions delivered with professionalism, quality and attention to detail.

Request a Quote

Electrical Installation & Rewiring

New wiring and full rewires for homes, shops, offices and multi-storey buildings, floor by floor.

Distribution Boards

Main DB and sub-DB design and installation, cable sizing, and load balancing across circuits.

Solar PV Systems

Panel mounting, hybrid and off-grid inverter setup, battery banks and PV distribution boards, 5–15kW residential systems.

Generators & ATS

Generator installation, manual and automatic transfer switch wiring, and backup circuit planning for essential loads.

Testing & Commissioning

Insulation resistance, earth continuity, RCD and phase rotation testing with Megger and digital multimeters before handover.

Pipework & Conduit

GI trunking, heavy-duty conduit installation, bending and threading, plus cable tray and ladder runs.

WHY CHOOSE US

Nothing gets energised until it's been checked.

ERA licensed and working to BS 7671 and ERA/UEC regulations, with testing built into every stage.

Lock-Out, Tag-Out

Circuits are isolated and tagged before anyone works on them — no live working on switchboards.

Tested Before Handover

IR, earth continuity, RCD and phase rotation checks on every installation.

Regulation Compliant

Work follows BS 7671 and ERA/UEC standards, with proper earthing throughout.

PPE & Site Discipline

Protective equipment worn as standard, with clients briefed on hazards during the job.
